name: report_progress
label: Report Progress
description: Report your current task progress as a percentage (0-100). Call this whenever you make meaningful progress on your task.

message.description: Brief status message describing what you are doing

name: complete_task
label: Complete Task
description: Mark a task as completed with final deliverables. Workers call this when their assigned task is done. Lead calls this for parent tasks when all children are done.

deliverable.description: Final deliverable: code, analysis result, document content, etc.

task_id.description: Task ID to complete. If omitted, completes your current assigned task.

name: submit_task
label: Submit Task
description: (Lead only) Register one tracked root task for a genuinely multi-step HUMAN request. A single source chat message has exactly one root, even if the title changes. Do not create a second root to polish or revise wording; reuse the existing root and close it with an ordered acceptance summary. If the request is simple, answer directly without submit_task.

title.description: Short, verifiable title of the request (becomes the root task title)

description.description: The full user request plus its constraints, in the user's own terms — this is what you will decompose and later verify each deliverable against

budget_minutes.description: 任务执行预算(分钟,可选;缺省用平台 root_timeout_ms)。长链路(多阶段巡检/AML 训练链)建议显式给足,如 60 —— 预算从入场起算,超预算未完成会被超时收口。

name: dispatch_task
label: Dispatch Task
description: (Lead only) Create one bounded child under an existing parent and assign it to a worker. The platform enforces finite root budgets (total child attempts, active children, canceled children, and ordinary depth); changing the title does not reset them. Freeze the child ID/title/contract after dispatch. Prefer update_task, send_message_to_agent, or reassign_task over cancel-and-recreate. Always include parent_task_id, route_reason, and a self-contained objective/deliverable/acceptance/boundary brief.

assignee_id.description: ID of the worker agent to assign this task to

route_reason.description: Why this agent was chosen (specialty fit / load / past success evidence) — one short line, kept as the auditable routing decision

parent_task_id.description: The ID of the submitted parent task this subtask belongs to (from the task list)

grant_node_ids.description: 可选(Lead only):随本任务把节点授权授予 assignee —— 数组元素为节点 id,每个节点必须是 lead 自己已绑定的节点(daq/dcw 均可);任一节点不在 lead 绑定面则整单失败、任务不创建。用于派发时一并下发 DAQ/DCW 权限,worker 无需再等手动绑定。

grant_mode.description: 可选:随任务授予的绑定模式;缺省随 lead 自己的绑定模式(manual=每次写入需用户批准)

name: send_message_to_agent
label: Send Message
description: Send a message to another agent (lead or worker) in the same channel via the channel mailbox (routed to the recipient's own mailbox). Use priority "immediate" for urgent real-time messages that the recipient sees instantly during work; use "task" (default) for messages that queue until the recipient finishes their current task. Set require_reply=true to demand a response: the recipient must reply with their result via this same tool. When replying to a message, pass its message_id as in_reply_to — replies are auto-upgraded to real-time delivery and pushed straight into the recipient's running session, so the answer reaches a waiting sender instantly.

message.description: Message content (when replying: your execution result + the content they asked for)

priority.description: Message priority: "immediate" = inject into recipient's running session instantly; "task" = queue for later consumption (default)

require_reply.description: Trigger: true = recipient MUST reply with result/content (default false)

in_reply_to.description: Message ID this reply refers to (set when replying to a trigger message)

name: poll_messages
label: Poll Inbox
description: Check your own mailbox for unread messages from other agents. When waiting for a reply, pass wait_seconds (e.g. 90) to block until it arrives or the wait expires — one blocking call replaces repeated empty polling. Returned collaboration messages are acknowledged on read (removed from the queue); task assignments are left for execution. Replies to your trigger messages are also pushed into your running session in real time — if you already saw an injected "[实时消息 from X]", that IS the reply, no need to poll again.

wait_seconds.description: Block up to N seconds (0-180) waiting for a message before returning empty (default 0 = immediate check)

name: read_channel_mail
label: Read Channel Mail
description: (Lead only) Read the FULL channel mail log: every message routed through the channel mailbox (peer messages, real-time replies with in_reply_to chains, and task deliveries), newest first, with read/unread state. Pass agent_id to inspect a specific member's mailbox. Use this BEFORE dispatching a task whose result may already exist — if a worker already computed/delivered the value via mail, do NOT re-dispatch it; reference the concrete result from the mail instead.

agent_id.description: Optional: only show mails involving this agent (as sender or recipient)

name: broadcast_message
label: Broadcast
description: Broadcast a message to ALL agents in the channel (lead + all workers). Useful for announcements.

name: list_channel_tasks
label: List Tasks
description: List all tasks in the current channel, including their status, progress, and assignee.

name: list_team_agents
label: List Team
description: List all agents in the current channel (lead + workers) with their roles and names.

name: get_task_details
label: Get Task
description: Get detailed information about a specific task, including artifacts and history.

name: get_my_task_queue
label: My Queue
description: View your own task queue: pending tasks (FIFO order), the task you are currently executing, and completed tasks. Use this to check if you have unfinished work.

name: get_queue_overview
label: Queue Overview
description: (Lead only) Real-time overview of every team member: status (idle/busy), current task, pending queue length, completed count. Use this to make optimal scheduling and rebalancing decisions.

name: reassign_task
label: Reassign Task
description: (Lead only) Move a pending (not yet started) or failed task from one worker to another. Use for load rebalancing or when a worker is stuck. The old worker's queued delivery is revoked automatically.

to_agent_id.description: Worker agent ID to receive the task

name: update_task
label: Update Task
description: (Lead only) Modify the title/description of a pending (queued, not started) task. The assignee's queued delivery is refreshed with the new content automatically.

name: cancel_task
label: Cancel Task
description: Cancel a task only when it is genuinely abandoned or blocked. Canceling a parent cascades to all non-terminal descendants and stops matching active runs; cancellation consumes the root budget. Do not cancel to rename/polish/revise a task. Prefer messaging, update_task, or reassign_task. Pending queued deliveries are revoked automatically.

name: search_memory
label: Search Memory
description: Search your persistent memory (hybrid keyword+semantic retrieval over your private memories and the channel's shared team memories). Results may include: your task history, the TEAM CHRONICLE (团队编年史 = rolling log of everything the team finished), past SESSION COMPACTION SUMMARIES (会话压缩摘要 = conclusions from earlier context windows), monthly reflections (作业反思), and shared conventions. Use this ANY TIME you need prior context: before starting a task, when you suspect relevant past work exists, or when the injected memory hints/brief mention something you need details on. Pass a focused query describing what you want to remember.

query.description: What you want to recall, e.g. "数据库连接池配置结论" or "previous deployment checklist"

scope.description: Which memory domain to search: "auto" = your private + channel shared (default), "private" = only your own, "shared" = only channel-wide shared memories

name: save_memory
label: Save Memory
description: Persist a distilled, reusable insight into memory for future tasks. scope="private" saves to YOUR personal memory (only you recall it); scope="shared" saves to the CHANNEL shared memory visible to ALL teammates (use for conclusions, conventions, or knowledge the whole team benefits from — not task-specific minutiae). Distill before saving: title = short topic, content = the reusable conclusion. Use a stable dedup_key to update an existing memory instead of duplicating. NOTE: the platform already auto-archives task outcomes, team results, the team chronicle, and session compaction summaries — never save whole task logs or raw session transcripts.

title.description: Short topic title, e.g. "API 网关限流方案结论"

scope.description: "private" = your memory only; "shared" = channel-wide shared memory for all teammates

dedup_key.description: Stable key for idempotent update (same key overwrites instead of duplicating)

name: create_team_agent
label: Create Team Agent
description: (Lead only) Create a NEW worker only when capability/load evidence shows existing members cannot handle the work. Reuse existing workers first. The platform enforces a per-Channel worker roster cap, including disabled members; do not retry with another name after TEAM_WORKER_LIMIT.

name.description: Short, descriptive member name, e.g. "db-migrator" or "test-writer"

harness.description: Agent harness: "omp" = full LLM agent with native work tools (default, use this for real work), "mock" = scripted test agent, "claude" = claude harness

system_prompt.description: System prompt prefix defining this member's specialty, working style, and conventions (maps to its systemPromptPrefix config)

reason.description: Why this member is being added (shown to the user in the team event timeline)

name: update_team_agent
label: Update Team Agent
description: (Lead only) Update an existing team member (worker): rename it, revise its system prompt (e.g. to specialize or correct its behavior), or enable/disable it. The member's runtime reloads with the new config on its next assignment. You cannot update yourself.

agent_id.description: ID of the worker agent to update (from list_team_agents)

system_prompt.description: New system prompt prefix defining its specialty/conventions (optional)

enabled.description: true = activate member, false = disable member (disabled members receive no new tasks; default true)

reason.description: Why this change is made (shown in the team event timeline)

name: remove_team_agent
label: Remove Team Agent
description: (Lead only) Remove a worker from your channel's team. Its queued tasks are automatically re-dispatched to the remaining worker with the shortest queue (or failed for retry if it was mid-execution), so no work is lost — but the member's context is. Use ONLY for sustained idle surplus or persistent underperformance; never as an experiment, and avoid removing members with active work. You cannot remove yourself.

agent_id.description: ID of the worker agent to remove

reason.description: Why this member is removed (shown in the team event timeline)

name: refuse_task
label: Refuse Task
description: Reject a task assigned to you because it is outside your capability or work scope (wrong recipient, unrelated domain, or missing prerequisites). The task is marked FAILED with your reason and a rejection notice is immediately sent back to the dispatcher (task creator, or the channel lead), who should reassign it to a fitting member. Use this INSTEAD of silently ignoring the task or doing unrelated work; do NOT use it for tasks you are able to do, and do NOT use cancel_task for refusals.

task_id.description: ID of the task you are refusing (must be assigned to you)

reason.description: Why the task is out of your scope: capability mismatch / wrong recipient / prerequisites missing. Be specific so the dispatcher can reassign properly.

name: my_industrial_nodes
label: My Industrial Nodes
description: 列出你的全部工业绑定与语义卡 —— 数控节点(PLC/MES 集成点位)与数采节点逐张卡:物理量/单位/量程/精度、工艺语义(物理机理与调参守则)、安全量程与活动配方工艺窗口、当前设定值、下发链路(PLC 驱动或 MES writeHook 单字段)、单步上限与操作守则;以及你绑定的配方操作面(运行状态/绑定模式 manual=逐动作 HITL 或 auto=免批/二级认证状态/参数对照表含参数键与描述)。在进行任何工业操作前必须先调用本工具;绑定前提:节点需 daq/dcw(存量)绑定,配方需 recipe 绑定 —— 未绑定对象不出现在清单中。

name: dcw_read
label: DCW Read
description: 读取绑定的数控节点的 PLC 当前值(读写集成的读半边)。返回 PLC 实时读数(经标定解码的物理量纲)与设定值对照;用于下发前取证、下发后复核设定是否生效。读取是被动观测,不影响控制状态,也不需要审批。 【数值口径:value=平台下发设定值,readValue=PLC 实测反馈;写保持窗/断链期两者可能短暂不一致,引用时注明口径】

name: param_read
label: Param Read
description: 按工艺参数(key 语义键或 pp-id)读取执行节点当前值与分层限界明细(节点量程∩参数基准∩产品限界∩配方窗口,单步上限来源)。被动观测免审批;参数键目录(含每参数的描述)在回包中给出。参数写入已收敛到配方面(recipe_update/recipe_apply),本工具只读。 【数值口径:value=平台下发设定值,readValue=PLC 实测反馈;写保持窗/断链期两者可能短暂不一致,引用时注明口径】

param.description: 工艺参数 id(pp-*)或参数 key

line_id.description: 产线 id(可选;参数 key 跨产线同名时用于消歧)

name: daq_query
label: DAQ Query
description: 从时序数据库检索你绑定的数采节点的历史/实时数据。支持按产线/产品/配方/批次/时间窗/降采样多维过滤(产品/配方过滤基于逐样本打标,可精确取某批次数据);返回结果携带物理含义(参数语义/单位/量程/统计摘要/最近序列)。默认只取**当前活动批次(活动配方)**的数据:产线正在跑什么配方就只查那个配方,不会把上一轮配方的样本混进本轮判读;需要跨配方看整段历史时显式传 scope=all。

node_id.description: 限定单个数采节点 id(缺省 = 全部绑定节点)

line_id.description: 按产线过滤(数据归属产线)

product_id.description: 按产品过滤(逐样本打标);显式传入即覆盖默认的活动批次过滤

recipe_id.description: 按配方过滤(逐样本打标);显式传入即覆盖默认过滤。缺省 = 该节点所在产线的活动配方(产线未开跑则不过滤)

run_id.description: 按批次 run 过滤(同一配方多次开跑时精确定位某一次);显式传入即覆盖默认过滤

scope.description: 作用域:active(缺省)= 只取当前活动批次;all = 不做配方过滤,返回窗口内全部样本(跨配方对比/历史复盘用)

last_minutes.description: 最近 N 分钟(缺省 30)

from_ms.description: 起始 epoch ms(与 to_ms 配合,优先于 last_minutes)

bucket_ms.description: 时间间隔(降采样桶宽 ms):缺省 {queryDefaultBucketMs}(15s);可调,下限 {queryMinBucketMs}。不传即用缺省;系统配置变更后以新值为准

name: dcw_judge
label: DCW Judge
description: 对你发起的优化记录(调控 step)落判定。keep=已验证经验(配方可标 lastGood);rollback=判定应回退(判定入册后必须再调 dcw_rollback 执行,判定不自动改 PLC);uncertain=证据不足保持观察。判定必须引用数采证据(daq_query 窗口数据),禁止无证据判定。

record_id.description: 优化记录 id(dcw_control 下发成功后返回)

reason.description: 判定理由(必须引用具体数值/时间窗证据)

name: dcw_journal
label: DCW Journal
description: 查询参数变更史与优化记录(在册审计):谁/何时/从多少到多少/判定结论/假设声明。优化前先读史可避免重复试错;回退定位也在此查。

node_id.description: 限定数控节点 id(仅限自己绑定的节点)

limit.description: 返回条数上限(缺省 20,最大 100)

name: send_cross_channel_message
label: Cross-Channel Message
description: [Leader only] Send a message to the LEADER of another channel, so the two teams can collaborate without being siloed. The message lands directly in the target channel leader mailbox; that leader will read your request and act on it (dispatch tasks in their channel, gather info, etc.) and can reply to you via the mailbox. Params: to_channel_id accepts the target channel id OR its exact name; message is your request to the other leader (state your need, deadline and what you expect back); require_reply=true to demand a response. Only channel leaders may call this tool - workers will be rejected. When replying to a cross-channel request you received, use this same tool addressed to the requester channel.

to_channel_id.description: Target channel id or exact name (must be another channel, not your own)

message.description: Request text for the target channel leader: what you need, why, and what to return

require_reply.description: true = demand the target leader reply with their result/answer

name: list_other_teams
label: List Other Teams
description: [Leader only] Overview of the OTHER teams (channels) in this workspace: each team name, description, lead, its in-progress scenario tasks, recently completed tasks, and how many shared memories it has (shared_memories > 0 means searchable knowledge exists - use search_other_teams_memory with that team). Decision flow: found knowledge -> reuse it directly; relevant work in progress but no knowledge yet -> message their leader via send_cross_channel_message; nothing -> consider whether your request justifies starting collaboration. Workers cannot call this tool.

name: search_other_teams_memory
label: Search Other Teams Memory
description: [All members] Read-only search across the SHARED memory of other teams (channels) in this workspace - what other teams have learned/concluded/done. Use it to reuse existing knowledge instead of asking for it: if you find relevant results, apply them directly; if nothing relevant exists but the other team is working on it, ask your leader to message that team leader via send_cross_channel_message. Results are attributed to their team.

query.description: What to look for (keywords of the knowledge/conclusion)

name: daq_export
label: DAQ Export
description: Export the FULL raw time-series (no downsampling) of your BOUND daq nodes(仅限你绑定的数采节点,越权 id 一律拒绝) to the platform data directory: one CSV per node (columns ts_iso,ts_ms,value,state) plus manifest.json containing the node mapping (name/unit/range/semantics), line-product-recipe-run context, recipe monitor windows and alarm statistics. Use when analysis needs complete waveforms rather than daq_query statistics: hand the export_id to diag_run (deep root-cause diagnosis) or hand the absolute directory to other workers for offline analysis.

node_ids.description: Comma/space separated node ids to export (default = all bound daq nodes); out-of-scope ids are rejected

line_id.description: Only export nodes of this line (narrowing filter)

from_ms.description: Window start epoch ms (together with to_ms; overrides last_minutes)

last_minutes.description: Last N minutes (default 60; window capped at 7 days)

title.description: Short title of this export recorded in manifest.json (e.g. 膜厚越限诊断数据集)

note.description: Scenario note for the analyst/IDD written into manifest.json (symptoms, suspected cause, what to look at)

merge.description: 合并导出:额外在导出目录生成 merged.csv(多节点按时间秒级对齐的多参数宽表,列名=节点名),可直接交给 IDD 哨兵/experience 等按 CSV 文件分析的服务

name: daq_frames
label: DAQ Frames
description: Query multi-modal DAQ frames for your BOUND daq nodes: multi-point profiles (thickness scanners, profile scanners — returns point-count summary, a point preview and derived metrics) and camera image frames (CCD — returns resolution, object reference and derived metrics like brightness/contrast; pixels are NOT loaded into context, view them in the frontend gallery). Supports kind=vector|image filter and time windows. Use BEFORE judging surface quality or profile measurements.

node_id.description: Limit to one bound daq node id (optional; default all your bound daq nodes)

line_id.description: Filter by line id (can only narrow, never widen your access)

last_minutes.description: Time window in minutes back from now (default 30)

name: ops_log
label: Ops Log
description: 查询你负责产线的运维日志(数控下发/优化判定/回退/配方下发/产线事件,新→旧)。来源区分 Agent/用户/系统:Agent 的操作者格式为「Channel名/成员名」。用于作业前后自查:你对节点做过哪些操作、他人或系统做过哪些干预。

line_id.description: 限定产线 id(须为你绑定节点所属产线;缺省=全部负责产线)

node_id.description: 限定数控/数采节点 id(须为你绑定的节点)

kind.description: 按分类过滤:write(下发)/recipe(配方)/rollback(回退)/daq(采集)/line(产线)

minutes.description: 回看窗口(分钟,缺省 1440=24 小时)

limit.description: 返回条数上限(缺省 20,最大 100)

mine.description: true=只看你自己发起的操作

name: recipe_log
label: Recipe Change Log
description: 查询你负责产线的 Recipe 变更史:配方一键下发(recipe.apply)、优化开窗、判定、回退执行(新→旧)。你据此知道配方层面对当前节点做过哪些下发变更、由谁执行、是否已回退。节点级参数值逐笔历史用 dcw_journal。

line_id.description: 限定产线 id(须为你绑定节点所属产线;缺省=全部负责产线)

minutes.description: 回看窗口(分钟,缺省 1440=24 小时)

limit.description: 返回条数上限(缺省 20,最大 100)

name: line_context
label: Line Context
description: 读取你控制的产线/产品/配方全景(动手前必读):产线场景说明、运行状态与活动批次、产品说明、活动配方(名称/版本/描述)逐参数目标值 vs PLC 当前值 vs 工艺窗口(附参数键与参数描述)、我绑定的节点与配方清单(含执行中/未运行标注)、已知良好批次;无活动批次时列出产线配方定义。可见性=节点授权线 ∪ 绑定配方所在线 ∪ 频道绑定线(只读);确认归属与现状后再用 recipe_* 工具操作。 【数值口径:value=平台下发设定值,readValue=PLC 实测反馈;写保持窗/断链期两者可能短暂不一致,引用时注明口径】

line_id.description: 限定产线 id(须为你绑定节点所属产线;缺省=全部负责产线)

name: recipe_versions
label: Recipe Versions
description: 查看指定配方的参数版本史(旧→新):每条含版本号、时间、来源(用户/Agent/系统)、操作者人话名、变更原因与参数 diff。用途:回退前确认目标版本内容、复盘谁改了什么为什么改。可见性=该配方所在产线可读即可(节点授权线 ∪ 绑定配方线 ∪ 频道绑定线);回退操作走 recipe_rollback(写门,manual 绑定需 HITL)。

recipe_id.description: 配方 id(必填;line_context 可看到)

limit.description: 返回最近 N 条(缺省 20,最大 50)

name: recipe_update
label: Recipe Update
description: 把验证过的最佳参数保存进指定配方(生成新版本,带归因与理由)。权限模型:须已绑定该 recipe(可绑定多个配方)且通过其二级认证;配方必须正在执行(运行门,未运行拒绝);绑定 manual 时本次保存挂 HITL 等人工批准——reason 必填且要给出判断依据(数采证据/分析结论),审批卡会向人类展示。只改配方定义,要把参数推到运行中的产线用 recipe_apply。

params.description: 要更新的参数列表(部分合并,只列要改的节点)

node_id.description: 数控节点 id(须为你绑定 dcw 的节点)

reason.description: 保存原因(必填;写明依据)

name: recipe_rollback
label: Recipe Rollback
description: 回退配方参数到稳定版本(指定历史版本或已知良好批次),生成新版本(非破坏);dispatch=true 时统一回退(定义回退+参数整批重下发)。权限模型:须已绑定该 recipe 且过二级认证与运行门;绑定 manual 时挂 HITL——reason 必填说明回退原因(如优化劣化/越限)。

version.description: 回退到该历史版本(version 与 to_last_good 二选一)

to_last_good.description: true=回退到已知良好批次参数冻结

dispatch.description: true=统一回退:定义回退后把恢复参数整批重下发到 PLC(优化闭环劣化时用);缺省 false=仅回退配方定义

emergency.description: 应急豁免配方下发间隔频控(不豁免审批;审批卡将标注【应急】并仍需人工批准;滥用会留审计痕迹)

name: mes_catalog
label: MES Catalog
description: 检索 MES REST 点位目录(driver=mes-rest 的数控点位)。每条含 id/名称/产线/单位/量程与能力位(读=当前值,写=设定值,史=可取历史;史·vector=每时间点一个检测向量如膜厚断面/双折射光谱,史·image=图像帧如 CCD 相机,史·table/史·event=表格/事件记录流,钩子=该点位已配置数据下沉处理)与点位描述。是 mes_fetch 取数的寻址入口;支持按关键字(q,匹配名称与描述)与产线(line_id)过滤。只读目录,不触达设备。可见性=你绑定的数控点位与你绑定配方内的参数点位(未绑定点位不可见,不触达设备)。

q.description: 关键字子串过滤(匹配点位名称与描述)

limit.description: 返回条数上限(缺省 20,最大 100)

name: mes_fetch
label: MES Fetch
description: 从 MES REST 点位取数(代码级护栏:仅限你绑定的数控点位;时间窗 ≤7 天;单次 ≤5000 行;每 60 秒最多 6 次)。格式自适应:标量点位回统计摘要;向量点位(每时间点一个检测向量,如膜厚断面 48 道)回按行均值的统计+维度+首中末采样;图像点位(如 CCD 帧)自动把帧落盘为文件、回包只给文件名与大小,图像 base64 永不进入对话;表格/事件点位回记录采样。若点位配置了数据钩子(dataHook),取数后会自动执行用户预设的下沉处理(绘图存档/存 CSV/统计),回包附处理摘要、处理说明与产物文件清单——直接引用它们,不要要求再给原文。param 对象会透传给钩子(如 {"lane": 12} 只看某车道)。三种模式:不传 from/to = 当前值快照直读;from/to 且 max_rows≤2000 = 同步内联;max_rows>2000 = 异步落 CSV 数据集(仅标量/向量;图像/表格/事件只支持内联),返回 job_id/dataset_id —— 勿轮询,用 mes_datasets 查状态、mes_dataset_read 读内容。

ids.description: 目标点位 id 数组(mes_catalog 输出的 id;须为你绑定的数控点位)

from.description: 窗口起点 ISO 时间(与 to 成对;都不传=当前值快照模式)

to.description: 窗口终点 ISO 时间(与 from 成对;窗口 ≤7 天)

max_rows.description: 行数上限(缺省 500,硬上限 5000;>2000 走异步数据集)

param.description: 透传给点位数据钩子的参数对象(Agent 只传业务参数,如 {"lane":12,"agg":"mean"};请求构造与数据处理逻辑由点位配置决定);无钩子点位可省略

name: mes_dataset_read
label: MES Dataset Read
description: 读取 MES 取数数据集(mode=head=列名+总行数概览;mode=stats=count/min/max/mean/stddev/首末时间;mode=rows=offset 起每页 20 行分页)。仅创建者、该点位绑定者或该产线可读者可读;回包只带 ≤3 行采样,统计判读请用 mode=stats。

dataset_id.description: 数据集 id(mes_fetch 异步回包或 mes_datasets 清单)

offset.description: rows 模式的起始行号(缺省 0)

name: mes_datasets
label: MES Datasets
description: 列出你可读的 MES 数据集清单(新→旧;含 dataset_id/点位/时间窗/行数/状态)。用于找回 mes_fetch 异步作业的 dataset_id 与确认取数状态 —— 替代轮询,作业未完成时先做别的任务。

limit.description: 返回条数上限(缺省 20,最大 100)

name: aml_node_catalog
label: AML Node Catalog
description: 列出你可用的 AML 建模节点(全部 daq 绑定):节点 id/名称/物理语义/单位/量程/所属产线/近 24h 是否有批次打标数据。开始任何自动建模前先调用本工具选节点(control=可控输入/target=预测目标/feature=仅历史特征);无绑定会给出指引。

name: aml_dataset_build
label: AML Dataset Build
description: 构建 AML 训练数据集:按隔离三元组(产线/产品/配方,防配方串味)拉取批次打标数据,清洗(状态/量程/Hampel)后对齐到 beat_ms 网格,按批次滑窗切分 train/val/test。鉴权:每个 node_id 都必须有你的 daq 绑定且归属 line_id(绑定只缩不放)。返回 dataset_id、行数、窗口计数、逐节点清洗摘要、控制→目标滞后估计。

line_id.description: 产线 id(必填;line_context 可查)

nodes.description: 节点与角色列表(≥2 项,必须含 1 个 target)

node_id.description: 数采节点 id(须有你的 daq 绑定)

role.description: control=可控输入(未来轨迹已知)/ target=预测目标 / feature=仅历史特征

history_steps.description: 历史窗口步数(1~2048;覆盖主要滞后即可)

horizon_steps.description: 预测步长(1~512;mpc_surrogate 建议覆盖调控响应期)

purpose.description: 建模目的:mpc_surrogate=代理模型(缺省)/ quality_predict=质量预测

note.description: 数据集备注(为什么建这个数据集)

run_ids.description: 限定批次 id 列表(缺省 = 该配方全部已完结批次)

force.description: 熔断逃生口:10 分钟内已构建过同规格数据集时,默认拒绝并复用既有 dataset_id;确因数据已更新需要重建才传 true(防重试循环烧穿磁盘配额)。

name: aml_dataset_stats
label: AML Dataset Stats
description: 查看数据集完整统计报告:逐节点 mean/std/p05/p50/p95/缺失率/清洗率、控制→目标滞后估计、逐批次目标均值轮廓(漂移检测)、train/val/test 窗口计数。提交训练前用它确认数据质量。

name: aml_job_submit
label: AML Job Submit
description: 提交训练作业(内联 train.py 全文,≤500KB)。代码契约:必须 import amlkit;amlkit.load_bundle(datasetPath) 加载数据集;amlkit.report_progress(pct, note) 上报进度(防停摆误杀);amlkit.export_torch_onnx(model, manifest) 导出模型到 artifacts/model.onnx(契约缺失=永久失败);模型接口=one-step:输入 [batch, history_steps, 全节点数](归一化)→ 输出 [batch, 目标数](归一化)。change_note 遵守单组件改动纪律:每次实验只改一个组件(网络/特征/超参之一)并写明。

code.description: train.py 全文(≤500KB,须 import amlkit 并导出 artifacts/model.onnx)。job_kind=hybrid_residual 时可省略:平台自动使用内置参考训练器(物理参数校准→有界残差集成→UQ 校准)

change_note.description: 本次实验改动说明(必填;单组件改动纪律:只改一个组件,写明改了什么与预期)

params.description: 超参数字典(如 {"epochs": 50, "lr": 0.001};传入训练代码的 job.json.params)

purpose.description: 建模目的(缺省继承数据集 spec)

parent_experiment_id.description: 父实验 id(谱系对照:本次是在哪个实验基础上改的)

scene_id.description: Hybrid Twin 场景 id（可选；写入作业谱系）

physics_spec.description: 已冻结 SceneContract 对应的声明式 PhysicsSpec；平台会在隔离 workspace 写入 physics_spec.json

physics_manifest.description: 物理模型 manifest 快照

model_name.description: 模型人读标识(可选,≤80 字符):注册时作 label 前缀;平台会自动追加「产品/配方·优化目标」谱系尾,换配方或换目标的模型必须能从名字区分

model_description.description: 建模意图描述(可选,≤500 字符):写清本模型针对的场景/配方与优化目标;缺省由平台按谱系派生

name: aml_job_status
label: AML Job Status
description: 查看训练作业状态:状态/阶段(provision→train→evaluate)/进度/平台门禁逐项(G1 单步/G2 滚动 NRMSE 等)/错误。不带 job_id 列出最近 10 个;带 job_id 看单作业详情。训练中建议 30~60 秒轮询一次。

job_id.description: 作业 id(缺省 = 列最近 10 个)

name: aml_job_logs
label: AML Job Logs
description: 查看 AML 训练/评估作业的日志行(按 job_id;含加载/训练/门禁/导出各阶段输出)。用于失败归因(如数据不足/门禁未过)与进度确认;作业终态回执已自动送达信箱,本工具用于补看细节。

name: aml_job_cancel
label: AML Job Cancel
description: 取消排队/运行中的训练作业(运行中的会终止进程树;取消动作入册可审计)。数据集不受影响,可复用重训。

name: aml_leaderboard
label: AML Leaderboard
description: 查看数据集的实验谱系表(新→旧):每条实验的 change_note/父实验/状态/G1 单步与 G2 滚动 NRMSE/门禁通过情况,并标注当前最优(门禁通过且 G1 最小);同时列出已登记模型(model_id,晋升对象)。优化前先读榜,避免重复试错。

name: aml_model_find
label: AML Model Find
description: 模型发现与选型:按产线/产品/配方/purpose/优化目标/阶段过滤模型注册表,每个模型给出「label(产线·配方·优化目标标识)/阶段/G1+G2 指标/描述」,生产模型置顶,并按当前情况给出 选型指引:复用已有生产模型(aml_model_reference)→ 晋升候选(aml_model_promote,lead 专属)→ 新建模型(aml_dataset_build → aml_job_submit)。开始优化任务前先查:模型按 (产品, 配方, purpose) 隔离,不同 recipe 的模型不可跨用。

line_id.description: 限定产线 id(须为你绑定节点所属产线;缺省 = 全部负责产线)

recipe_id.description: 限定配方 id(配方隔离:换配方必须换模型,选型前务必指定)

objective_id.description: 限定优化目标(ObjectiveProfile id;hybrid twin 模型携带)

stage.description: 限定阶段(缺省 = 全部,production 置顶)

name: aml_model_promote
label: AML Model Promote
description: (Lead only) 晋升模型阶段:to_stage=shadow(影子观测)或 production(生产生效)。必须经人工审批(HITL 挂起,用户批准/拒绝/超时);批准晋升 production 时同组旧生产模型自动退役。worker 无此工具;模型 id 从 aml_leaderboard 查。

model_id.description: 模型 id(aml_leaderboard 的已登记模型段)

to_stage.description: 目标阶段:shadow=影子观测 / production=生产生效

name: aml_model_reference
label: AML Model Reference
description: 影子模型参考(调参前先问影子模型):拉取最近历史数据组装生产模型输入,按当前/指定控制轨迹预测未来每拍的目标值(物理量纲)。用于 dcw_control 下发前对比不同设定方案的目标响应;预测仅供参考,真实下发仍走安全联锁。product/recipe 缺省时取你绑定节点所属产线的唯一活动批次。

line_id.description: 限定产线 id(须为你绑定节点所属产线;多产线绑定且未给全 product/recipe 时必传以消歧)

product_id.description: 产品 id(缺省 = 活动批次)

recipe_id.description: 配方 id(缺省 = 活动批次)

controls.description: 控制节点设定值映射 {node_id: value}(候选方案;缺省 = 持最后观测)

steps.description: 滚动预测步数(≤ 模型 horizon;缺省 = 全 horizon)

name: twin_provider_catalog
label: Twin Provider Catalog
description: 读取当前已注册的场景 Provider、ScenePack、SolverAdapter 及 generation/health 元数据；只读，不执行控制。

name: twin_scene_discover
label: Twin Scene Discover
description: 读取当前 Agent 已绑定的 DAQ/DCW 节点，推断 control/state/disturbance/target/guard 语义并返回证据与置信度；只读，不执行控制。

name: twin_scene_compile
label: Twin Scene Compile
description: 根据已绑定节点和场景提示词生成 SceneContract Draft；默认 draft，首次训练/上线前必须由用户确认后冻结。

name: twin_scene_freeze
label: Twin Scene Freeze
description: 在用户明确确认后冻结 SceneContract；冻结后同一 scene_id/version 的契约不可覆盖，变更必须新建版本。

name: twin_physics_spec_draft
label: Twin PhysicsSpec Draft
description: 从场景(SceneContract,须含 nodeId 映射)自动生成骨架 PhysicsSpec:每个状态变量=一阶惯性弛豫方程(τ/控制增益为带先验盒的可校准参数),观测=持久性恒等基线,约束继承场景。这是任意工况建模的起点:生成后按真实物理润色方程 → twin_physics_spec_validate → twin_physics_spec_compile → aml_job_submit(job_kind=hybrid_residual,训练 stage A 会自动按数据拟合 τ/增益)。传 dt_sec 指定与数据集 beat 一致的步长(缺省 1s)。

scene_json.description: SceneContract 全文(hybrid Channel 已绑定冻结场景时可省略)

dt_sec.description: 求解步长(秒;应与训练数据集 beatMs/1000 一致,缺省 1)

name: twin_physics_spec_validate
label: Twin PhysicsSpec Validate
description: 校验孪生物理规格(PhysicsSpec)的结构与参数完整性:方程/常量/输入输出维度/量纲是否自洽。训练与评估前先校验,坏规格会在运行期才爆;校验回包给出逐项问题定位。

name: twin_physics_spec_compile
label: Twin PhysicsSpec Compile
description: 将已冻结场景的 PhysicsSpec 编译为隔离的 Generic Declarative Provider 候选并保存 artifact；不注册 production、不写 PLC。

name: twin_scene_read
label: Twin Scene Read
description: 读取绑定场景的机器可验证 SceneContract 与控制策略；仅返回场景/节点语义，不执行任何控制。

scene_id.description: 场景 id，缺省使用当前注塑 MVP 场景

name: twin_snapshot_create
label: Twin Snapshot Create
description: 根据服务端绑定的 DAQ 样本创建带 freshness/watermark/hash/binding epoch 的不可变 TwinSnapshot；Hybrid Twin 必须 auto_daq=true、冻结场景和 BindingSnapshot，禁止 Agent 伪造样本。

name: twin_trial_run
label: Twin Virtual Trial
description: 在隔离模型副本中注入候选控制轨迹，输出全轨迹约束、UQ/OOD 与收益；candidateExecuted=false，不触碰 PLC/DCW。传 model_id 时 rollout 由该训练注册的 hybrid 模型驱动(校准后物理主干+有界残差集成，UQ coverage 来自训练工件)，且模型谱系必须与场景 line/product/recipe 一致；不传则用场景物理 provider。

snapshot_id.description: 生产 VirtualTrial 使用已持久化 TwinSnapshot id；Hybrid Twin 必填

model_id.description: 驱动 rollout 的 AML 模型 id(须为 hybrid 模型且与场景同谱系；aml_model_find 可查)；缺省=场景物理 provider

name: mpc_optimize
label: MPC Recommendation Only
description: 先检查冻结 SceneContract、绑定快照、模型门禁；未通过时只生成 safe_small_step 小步参数试探，门禁通过后才允许更精确的候选搜索；始终 recommendation-only。传 model_id 时候选评估由该训练注册的 hybrid 模型 rollout(残差修正+集成 UQ)；不传则用场景物理 provider。

snapshot_id.description: 生产 MPC 使用已持久化 TwinSnapshot id；Hybrid Twin 必填

name: twin_gate_evaluate
label: Twin Gate Evaluate
description: 评估 AML 数据门、物理门、UQ/OOD、VirtualTrial 候选数量和硬约束；零候选/零分母自动拒绝。

name: twin_calibration_request
label: Twin Calibration Request
description: 按新 DAQ run/rows、漂移或误差阈值登记一次去重的自动校准候选；只进入 AgentTeam 校准队列，不覆盖 production，不写 DCW。

name: optimization_explore
label: Optimization Explore Step
description: 工艺优化探索步(探索模式核心):按 goal 与指定方向/步长生成激励值,经数控下发治理链(绑定鉴权/HITL/写限界)真实写入产线,等待工艺响应后读回目标量均值,并把【写入值↔响应值】配对落库为探索记录(训练数据回流的事实源)。步长缺省取绑定 tuning.step 或场景调试跨度;方向 up/down 由你依据节点物理意义判断。多轮迭代以积累「参数波动↔目标响应」数据,供 AML 修正训练与后续模型寻优。

control_node_id.description: 数控节点 id(缺省=第一个数控绑定)

target_node_id.description: 目标观测节点 id(缺省=第一个数采绑定)

direction.description: 激励方向(依据节点物理意义与 goal 偏差判断)

step.description: 激励步长(缺省=绑定 tuning.step 或场景 maxStep)

settle_seconds.description: 写入后等待工艺响应的秒数(10~300,缺省 45)

hypothesis.description: 本次探索假设(入册追溯)

name: twin_bayes_optimize
label: Twin Bayesian Optimize
description: AML 模式贝叶斯寻优(须已绑定通过门禁的 AML 模型):以绑定模型 rollout 为代理,围绕当前最优邻域多轮生成候选,UCB(μ-κ·σ)权衡利用与探索,产出收敛轨迹与最终受治理推荐(recommendation-only,写入须审批)。快照/绑定校验与 mpc_optimize 同源。

snapshot_id.description: 已持久化 TwinSnapshot id(必填,requireFresh)

name: aml_training_plan_list
label: AML Training Plan List
description: 建模任务清单(解耦编排面):列出全部建模任务的谱系绑定/策略(auto=新批次自动修正训练)/状态/最新模型与 spec 固化情况。

name: aml_training_plan_create
label: AML Training Plan Create
description: 创建建模任务(绑定产线/产品/配方三元组 + 数据集 IO 契约:control=DCW 输入,target=DAQ 输出 + 固化训练 spec)。auto 策略的任务在新批次(含工艺优化 Channel 的探索数据)到达时由平台自动修正训练;模型入册后可在 AML 界面绑定到工艺优化 Channel。

training_spec.description: 固化的 PhysicsSpec(含 modelId;来自 twin_physics_spec_draft/compile 流程)

name: aml_training_plan_train
label: AML Training Plan Train
description: 立即触发建模任务的修正训练:重建数据集(历史+新批次)→ 平台参考训练器 → 门禁 → 模型入册;plan 状态回写,AML 界面可渲染。

name: team_grant_nodes
label: Grant Nodes
description: (Lead only) Grant industrial node permissions (DAQ read / DCW control) to a worker in this channel. HARD RULE: every node must already be bound to YOU (the lead) — you cannot grant permissions beyond your own bindings. Grants are all-or-nothing: if any node is not in your binding surface, the whole request is rejected and nothing is granted. Use this before dispatching (so the worker can act immediately) or mid-execution when scope expands. The worker sees granted nodes via my_industrial_nodes. To grant together with a task, prefer dispatch_task(grant_node_ids=[...]). 可委派对象:数采节点(观察)与配方(recipe;被授予者获得该配方的参数写入/下发能力,受运行门与 HITL 约束)。每个对象必须已绑定你自己(绑定即前提,权限不可超越授予者)。

agent_id.description: Worker member instance id in this channel

node_ids.description: Node ids to grant (DAQ and/or DCW nodes; must all be bound to you, the lead)

mode.description: Optional binding mode for the granted nodes; default = the mode of YOUR own binding for that node (manual = every write needs user approval)

name: team_revoke_nodes
label: Revoke Nodes
description: (Lead only) Take back node permissions previously granted to a worker in this channel. You can revoke bindings you granted, or bindings for nodes you hold yourself; other bindings are reported as not revoked. Use when a task closes or scope narrows.

agent_id.description: Worker member instance id in this channel

node_ids.description: Node ids to revoke from this worker

name: recipe_trial
label: Recipe Trial
description: 多参数候选整批试验下发(不写配方版本)。权限模型:须已绑定该 recipe 且过二级认证与运行门;候选只能覆盖配方内参数节点;绑定 manual 时挂 HITL 等人工批准 —— hypothesis 必填,即本次试验的理由与判断依据,审批卡会向人类展示。整批一次落产线;复测判读后有进步用 recipe_update 固化,劣化用 recipe_rollback(dispatch=true) 统一回退。受同线试验节拍(默认 ≥5 分钟)与四层限界卡控。

recipe_id.description: 配方 id(必填;line_context 可看到当前配方)

params.description: 候选参数集(≥1条;一次把要改的参数都带上,整批下发防震荡)

hypothesis.description: 试验假设/依据(必填:知识库条目或数据分析结论)

emergency.description: 应急豁免配方下发间隔频控(不豁免审批;审批卡将标注【应急】并仍需人工批准;滥用会留审计痕迹)

name: recipe_apply
label: Recipe Apply
description: 把配方当前已固化参数整批下发到运行中的产线(改配方 recipe_update 之后用)。权限模型:须已绑定该 recipe 且过二级认证与运行门(配方须在执行);绑定 manual 时挂 HITL 等人工批准——reason 必填,说明为什么要下发、依据是什么。批准后整批经治理联锁(量程/步长/限速)下发,逐参数回执;拒绝可附指导,按指导修订后重提。

reason.description: 下发理由(必填):说明为什么这样调 —— 数据依据/试验结论/GOAL 差距分析,产线专家在审批卡上要能看懂你的判断逻辑

emergency.description: 应急豁免配方下发间隔频控(不豁免审批;审批卡将标注【应急】并仍需人工批准;滥用会留审计痕迹)

name: exp_collect
label: Exp Collect
description: 采集产线经验动作(经验工程师/产线医生共用):平台动作=平台有写入留痕的变更(锚账本增量,带来源归因/证据锚/人工裁决意见);推断动作=SET 变化且时间窗内平台无写入(疑似现场本地调整),只入待确认队列,人工确认后才进入经验总结。产出 episode 供总结入库;水位+哈希双剔重,重复调用幂等。纯只读,不写产线。

line_id.description: 限定产线 id(缺省=全部可读产线:节点授权线 ∪ 频道绑线)

name: aml_activity
label: AML Activity
description: 查询产线 AML 优化循环是否活动(只读自查):频道投用模型(production)/在跑优化作业/近 30 分钟优化事件三路信号。活动期间整包下发(recipe_propose)会被硬闸拒绝并降级为建议报告,提交方案前必须先查。纯只读,不写产线。

line_id.description: 限定产线 id(缺省=全部可读产线:节点授权线 ∪ 频道绑线)

name: recipe_propose
label: Recipe Propose
description: 提交整包优化方案审批(诊断工程师下发面,1~3 套候选方案一次审批):逐参数必须带 basis(为什么这样调)与 exp_ref(经验/证据引用);服务端先按配方真实限界预检(越界参数剔除,全部失效打回),再挂一张结构化审批单,等待人类在产线页选定方案批准。AML 优化活动期被硬闸拒绝(降级为建议);同一配方已有在飞审批单时软提示等待。批准后整批下发并回执逐参数结果+runId;拒绝/超时人工意见逐字回流。审批与绑定模式无关,永远人工裁决,绝不直写。

recipe_id.description: 配方 id(必填;line_context 可看到当前配方 id)

packages.description: 候选方案集(1~3 套;每套 { name, rationale?, params })

name.description: 方案名(审批卡展示,必填)

rationale.description: 方案总体思路与预期效果(建议提供)

params.description: 参数组(每条 { node_id, to, basis, exp_ref };from 缺省=服务端自取当前值)

node_id.description: 数控节点 id(须为配方内节点)

from.description: 当前值(可缺省;缺省时服务端自取节点现值)

basis.description: 依据:为什么这样调(必填;缺失该参数拒绝入包)

exp_ref.description: 经验/证据引用(知识库条目标题或数据证据;必填,缺失拒绝入包)

emergency.description: 应急豁免配方下发间隔频控(不豁免审批;审批卡将标注【应急】并仍需人工批准;滥用会留审计痕迹)

name: line_start
label: Line Start
description: 产线开跑(仅频道 lead):以指定配方开线并下发参数,激活该产线的批次窗口与数采打标。恒为 HITL —— 必须人工批准才执行;运行门/配方归属校验照常。reason 必填(工单/排产/实验依据)。

recipe_id.description: 配方 id(必填,须属于本频道绑定的产线)

reason.description: 开线理由(必填):工单/排产/实验目的,人工审批要能看懂

name: line_stop
label: Line Stop
description: 产线停线(仅频道 lead):关闭当前批次窗口(防跨批次污染)并停止该线数采。恒为 HITL —— 必须人工批准;reason 必填。停后数据保留可查。

reason.description: 停线理由(必填):完工/检修/异常

name: line_status
label: Line Status
description: 产线运行状态(只读):本频道绑定产线的活动批次/配方/打标样本数;未运行返回未运行态。

line_id.description: 产线 id(缺省=本频道绑定的产线)
